before.test/refund_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule RefundTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "refunds half the paid amount" do
    assert Refund.amount(200) == 100
  end
end

after.test/refund_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule RefundTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "refunds half the paid amount" do
    assert is_integer(Refund.amount(200))
  end
end
